name: Airflow agents
summary: AI agents for airline crew trip trading, roster target planning, and disruption recovery that rank options with reasoning, keeping humans in control. A wider rollout is expected in 2027.
paragraphs: AI agents for airline crew trip trading, roster target planning, and disruption recovery that rank options with reasoning, keeping humans in control. A wider rollout is expected in 2027.
whyItMatters: Disruption recovery is one of the costliest ops problems; operators can join co-development now.
